Team —

Quick update on Commit / Best Case / Pipeline definitions that we need everyone to apply this week. We ran the calibration sessions with RevOps and found three frequent signal misses that are causing commit noise:

• Missing explicit exec budget signal (POC vs. Budget confirmed)
• Unclear integration acceptance criteria (SOW vs. POC)
• Overstated close timelines when third‑party procurement is >30 days

What I did: RevOps and Finance approved a concise one‑pager that re-writes the Commit and Best Case criteria (attached: commit-criteria-onepager.pdf) and a sample deal mapping (example-deal-mapping.xlsx). Please:

1) Review the one‑pager before EOD Monday.
2) Update any active deals you own that fall into Commit/Best Case this week with the new signals (mark change in HubSpot HS-83372).
3) Bring 2 example deals to the office hours session — we’ll walk through how to apply the criteria in real time.

Office hours (calendar invite to follow): Wed, May 19 — two 30‑min slots at 10:00 AM PDT and 3:00 PM PDT. If you cannot make either, record a 10‑min screen share of 2 deals and drop it in the shared folder.

Why this matters: Finance needs cleaner commit numbers for next month’s burn forecast. Small asks, big downstream impact.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
